project.name: jalrakshak-backend-reactor
project.description: Aggregator/reactor POM so `mvn install` (or `mvn -pl module -am ...`) can build the three backend modules in one command, in the correct dependency order (shared must install before api-service and stream-processor, since they depend on it by groupId/artifactId/version rather than a Maven parent/relativePath relationship). This POM was previously missing; each module built independently and required `shared` to be `mvn install`-ed by hand first. This aggregator does not change any module's own POM, dependencies, or packaging.
